us-va-permits-p3-stafford-bos-minutes-20.summary: Item 19 considered a request to amend the proffered conditions on tax map parcel 39-71A (project known as Potomac Church Tech Center proffer amendment; proposed ordinance O26-25). The Director of Planning and Zoning told the Board that the amendment concerned potable-water use for the Potomac Church Data Center project, that the site lies on the east side of Old Potomac Church Road across from its intersection with South Campus Boulevard, and that the approved site development plan shows two proposed data center buildings: 'On the left was the first building that was now complete and occupied.' Under the existing proffers the first building may use potable water for cooling until reclaimed-water (reuse) lines reach the site, and the second building cannot be occupied until those lines are built; the amendment allows occupancy of the second building before the reuse system is complete, keeps the 217,000 gallons-per-day potable-water cap for both buildings for no more than 24 months after the second building's occupancy permit, requires bonds for the reuse upgrades and adds a USD 10 million transportation contribution due before that occupancy. The applicant's counsel said the site's Tier 2 generators had been approved in March 2025. The Planning Commission had recommended approval 6-0 on 13 May 2026, and the Board approved O26-25 by 4 votes to 2 with one member absent. The applicant's counsel said the construction process had started (without stating its scope) and gave July 2028 as the expected finish of the second building; the Director relayed the applicant's estimate that occupancy of the second shell would otherwise slip from April 2027 to 2029.
